subject: DI04005071

intro_text.en: Unit 4: how refinery streams are cleaned and finished — why and how sulfur is removed (Doctor sweetening, catalytic desulfurisation, MEROX), treatment of kerosene by liquid SO2 extraction, solvent extraction of lubes with furfural and phenol, and dewaxing with and without solvent, including ketone dewaxing. The extraction derivation and every numerical follow the locked style.
intro_text.gu: Unit 4: refinery streams કેવી રીતે સ્વચ્છ તથા finish થાય છે — sulfur કેમ અને કેવી રીતે દૂર થાય છે (Doctor sweetening, catalytic desulfurisation, MEROX), liquid SO2 extraction થી kerosene ની treatment, furfural તથા phenol સાથે lubes નું solvent extraction, અને solvent સાથે તથા વગર dewaxing, ketone dewaxing સહિત. Extraction derivation તથા દરેક numerical locked style મુજબ છે.

h.en: 4.1 Purposes and methods of sulfur removal — what sulfur does, and the three routes to remove it
h.gu: 4.1 Sulfur removal ના હેતુઓ તથા methods — sulfur શું કરે છે, અને તેને દૂર કરવાના ત્રણ માર્ગો

body.en:
Definition / principle

Sulfur occurs in fractions as hydrogen sulfide, mercaptans (RSH, foul-smelling and corrosive), sulfides, disulfides and thiophenes. Treatment either removes sulfur compounds, converts the most objectionable ones (mercaptans) to harmless ones, or destroys them with hydrogen.

Detailed theory and conditions

Sulfur must be controlled because it corrodes equipment and containers, poisons catalysts (reformer platinum, FCC catalyst), gives products a foul odour and poor stability/colour, and produces sulfur oxides when fuels burn. The method is chosen by how much sulfur, and of what kind, must go: (i) sweetening (Doctor, MEROX) converts mercaptans to disulfides — total sulfur hardly falls, but odour and corrosiveness disappear and the Doctor test passes; (ii) chemical/extractive treatment (caustic washing, liquid SO2 extraction) physically removes part of the sulfur compounds with aromatics; (iii) catalytic desulfurisation with hydrogen (hydrotreating, Unit III card 3.3) converts essentially all sulfur forms to H2S and is the only route that meets deep (ultra-low) sulfur specifications. Cost and hydrogen use rise in the same order.

Key points and data

  • Doctor test: a qualitative check for corrosive sulfur/mercaptans using sodium plumbite and sulfur; 'Doctor negative' means sweet.
  • Sweet ≠ desulfurised: a sweetened petrol can still contain almost all its original sulfur as disulfides.
  • Specification direction: modern fuel sulfur limits are so low that hydrotreating dominates; sweetening survives mainly for LPG/light streams and odour control.

Qualification

Choosing only the cheapest treatment that passes today's test fails when specifications tighten: sweetening leaves the sulfur in the fuel to become SOx on burning, which is why environmental rules, not just product smell, now decide the method.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Sulfur fractions માં hydrogen sulfide, mercaptans (RSH, દુર્ગંધયુક્ત તથા corrosive), sulfides, disulfides તથા thiophenes તરીકે હોય છે. Treatment કાં તો sulfur compounds ને દૂર કરે છે, કાં તો સૌથી વાંધાજનક (mercaptans) ને નિર્દોષમાં ફેરવે છે, કાં તો hydrogen થી તેમનો નાશ કરે છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Sulfur નિયંત્રિત કરવું જોઈએ કારણ કે તે equipment તથા containers ને corrode કરે છે, catalysts ને poison કરે છે (reformer platinum, FCC catalyst), products ને દુર્ગંધ તથા ખરાબ stability/colour આપે છે, અને fuels બળતાં sulfur oxides ઉત્પન્ન કરે છે. Method કેટલું sulfur, અને કયા પ્રકારનું, જવું જોઈએ તે પરથી પસંદ થાય છે: (i) sweetening (Doctor, MEROX) mercaptans ને disulfides માં ફેરવે છે — કુલ sulfur ભાગ્યે જ ઘટે છે, પણ દુર્ગંધ તથા corrosiveness જાય છે અને Doctor test pass થાય છે; (ii) chemical/extractive treatment (caustic washing, liquid SO2 extraction) sulfur compounds નો ભાગ aromatics સાથે ભૌતિક રીતે દૂર કરે છે; (iii) hydrogen સાથે catalytic desulfurisation (hydrotreating, Unit III card 3.3) લગભગ તમામ sulfur સ્વરૂપોને H2S માં ફેરવે છે અને deep (ultra-low) sulfur specifications પૂરો કરતો એકમાત્ર માર્ગ છે. ખર્ચ તથા hydrogen વપરાશ એ જ ક્રમમાં વધે છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Doctor test: sodium plumbite તથા sulfur વાપરી corrosive sulfur/mercaptans માટે qualitative check; 'Doctor negative' એટલે sweet.
  • Sweet ≠ desulfurised: sweetened petrol માં હજુ તેનું લગભગ બધું original sulfur disulfides તરીકે હોઈ શકે છે.
  • Specification દિશા: આધુનિક fuel sulfur limits એટલા નીચા છે કે hydrotreating પ્રભુત્વ ધરાવે છે; sweetening મુખ્યત્વે LPG/light streams તથા odour control માટે ટક્યું છે.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

આજનો test pass કરતી ફક્ત સૌથી સસ્તી treatment પસંદ કરવી specifications કડક થતાં fail થાય છે: sweetening sulfur ને fuel માં જ છોડે છે જે બળતાં SOx બને છે, તેથી જ હવે ફક્ત product ની ગંધ નહીં, environmental rules method નક્કી કરે છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Doctor sweetening treats sour petrol/LPG with sodium plumbite solution ('doctor solution') and elemental sulfur, converting corrosive, foul-smelling mercaptans into non-corrosive disulfides.

Equations and notation

The mercaptan first forms a lead mercaptide with the plumbite; added sulfur then breaks it down to lead sulfide (black) and the disulfide, regenerating caustic:

2 RSH + Na2PbO2 → (RS)2Pb + 2 NaOH
(RS)2Pb + S → (RS)2 + PbS (s)

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Sour feed is contacted with doctor solution in a mixer; mercaptans transfer to the aqueous phase and react.
  2. Elemental sulfur is added; black lead sulfide precipitates and is separated/settled out.
  3. The treated (sweet, Doctor-negative) product is washed and sent to storage; spent solution is handled as refinery chemical waste under plant rules.

Qualification

Doctor treatment converts, it does not remove: total sulfur in the product is nearly unchanged (mercaptan sulfur becomes disulfide sulfur), lead compounds make the process environmentally obsolete in most modern refineries, and it is included here as the classic method the syllabus names.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Doctor sweetening sour petrol/LPG ને sodium plumbite solution ('doctor solution') તથા elemental sulfur સાથે treat કરે છે, corrosive, દુર્ગંધયુક્ત mercaptans ને non-corrosive disulfides માં ફેરવે છે.

Equations and notation

Mercaptan પહેલાં plumbite સાથે lead mercaptide બનાવે છે; ઉમેરાયેલ sulfur પછી તેને તોડી lead sulfide (કાળો) તથા disulfide બનાવે છે, caustic regenerate કરે છે:

2 RSH + Na2PbO2 → (RS)2Pb + 2 NaOH
(RS)2Pb + S → (RS)2 + PbS (s)

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Sour feed mixer માં doctor solution ના સંપર્કમાં આવે છે; mercaptans aqueous phase માં જઈ react થાય છે.
  2. Elemental sulfur ઉમેરાય છે; કાળું lead sulfide precipitate થઈ છૂટું પાડી/બેસાડી દેવાય છે.
  3. Treated (sweet, Doctor-negative) product ધોવાઈ storage તરફ જાય છે; spent solution plant rules હેઠળ refinery chemical waste તરીકે handle થાય છે.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Doctor treatment ફેરવે છે, દૂર કરતું નથી: product માં કુલ sulfur લગભગ યથાવત રહે છે (mercaptan sulfur disulfide sulfur બને છે), lead compounds મોટાભાગની આધુનિક refineries માં આ process ને પર્યાવરણીય રીતે અપ્રચલિત બનાવે છે, અને તે અહીં syllabus જેનું નામ આપે છે તે classic method તરીકે સમાવ્યું છે.

h.en: 4.2(b) Catalytic desulfurization — hydrogen route to H2S (link to Unit III hydrotreating)
h.gu: 4.2(b) Catalytic desulfurization — H2S તરફ hydrogen માર્ગ (Unit III hydrotreating સાથે link)

body.en:
Definition / principle

Catalytic desulfurisation reacts sulfur compounds with hydrogen over a Co-Mo/Ni-Mo catalyst so that their sulfur leaves as hydrogen sulfide, which is absorbed in amine solution and converted to elemental sulfur in sulfur recovery.

Detailed theory and conditions

It is the deep form of the hydrotreating of Unit III (construction and working are given there): mercaptans, sulfides, disulfides and even refractory thiophenes are hydrogenolysed — for example a mercaptan RSH + H2 → RH + H2S. Severity (temperature, pressure, catalyst, hydrogen circulation) is raised until the product meets its sulfur specification, from kerosene smoke-point improvement to ultra-low-sulfur diesel. Numerical 4.N1 repeats the sulfur-balance discipline on a kerosene stream so that the comparison with sweetening (4.2(a)) is numerical, not verbal.

Key points and data

  • Only route that actually removes sulfur from the fuel system (as recoverable sulfur).
  • Costs: hydrogen plant/load, high-pressure equipment, catalyst management.
  • By-product chain: sour gas → amine absorber → Claus sulfur recovery (stated as the route; design is outside this syllabus).

Qualification

The most refractory sulfur (substituted thiophenes in diesel) needs the severest conditions and can limit the whole unit; catalyst deactivation by metals/coke sets run length, so desulfurisation guarantees are always tied to feed and catalyst age.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Catalytic desulfurisation sulfur compounds ને Co-Mo/Ni-Mo catalyst પર hydrogen સાથે react કરે છે જેથી તેમનું sulfur hydrogen sulfide તરીકે નીકળે, જે amine solution માં શોષાઈ sulfur recovery માં elemental sulfur માં ફેરવાય છે.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

તે Unit III ના hydrotreating નું deep સ્વરૂપ છે (construction તથા working ત્યાં આપ્યા છે): mercaptans, sulfides, disulfides અને refractory thiophenes પણ hydrogenolyse થાય છે — દાખલા તરીકે mercaptan RSH + H2 → RH + H2S. Severity (temperature, pressure, catalyst, hydrogen circulation) product તેના sulfur specification ને મળે ત્યાં સુધી વધારાય છે, kerosene smoke-point સુધારાથી ultra-low-sulfur diesel સુધી. Numerical 4.N1 kerosene stream પર sulfur-balance શિસ્તનું પુનરાવર્તન કરે છે જેથી sweetening (4.2(a)) સાથેની સરખામણી numerical બને, મૌખિક નહીં.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • એકમાત્ર માર્ગ જે ખરેખર fuel system માંથી sulfur દૂર કરે છે (recoverable sulfur તરીકે).
  • ખર્ચ: hydrogen plant/load, high-pressure equipment, catalyst management.
  • By-product chain: sour gas → amine absorber → Claus sulfur recovery (માર્ગ તરીકે જણાવ્યું; design આ syllabus ની બહાર છે).

મર્યાદા / Qualification

સૌથી refractory sulfur (diesel માં substituted thiophenes) ને સૌથી severe conditions જોઈએ છે અને તે આખા unit ને મર્યાદિત કરી શકે છે; metals/coke થી catalyst deactivation run length નક્કી કરે છે, તેથી desulfurisation guarantees હંમેશા feed તથા catalyst age સાથે જોડાયેલી હોય છે.

h.en: 4.2(c) MEROX treatment — construction and working of mercaptan oxidation
h.gu: 4.2(c) MEROX treatment — mercaptan oxidation નું construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

MEROX (MERcaptan OXidation, UOP) sweetens LPG, petrol and kerosene by extracting mercaptans into caustic soda solution and oxidising them there with air, over a cobalt catalyst, to disulfides.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Extractor: sour feed contacts caustic solution; mercaptans (acidic in character) dissolve in the caustic as mercaptides.
  2. Oxidiser (regenerator): the loaded caustic meets air over the catalyst; mercaptides become disulfides and the caustic is regenerated for reuse.
  3. Separator and settler: disulfide oil separates from the regenerated caustic; in liquid–liquid MEROX it is removed with the product stream arrangement of the design, and sweet product is washed/sanded as specified.

Working — sequence and reason

Extraction: RSH + NaOH → RSNa + H2O
Regeneration: 4 RSNa + O2 + 2 H2O → 2 (RS)2 + 4 NaOH

Because the caustic is regenerated, MEROX consumes mainly air and a little make-up caustic, replacing Doctor solution and its lead waste. Fixed-bed MEROX applies the same oxidation directly on a catalyst bed for heavier stocks.

Limitations and safety

Like Doctor treatment, MEROX sweetens without materially reducing total sulfur (mercaptan sulfur stays as disulfide, largely separated with the caustic loop in extraction designs). Caustic handling and mercaptan odour require closed systems and refinery PPE/procedures.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

MEROX (MERcaptan OXidation, UOP) LPG, petrol તથા kerosene ને mercaptans ને caustic soda solution માં extract કરી ત્યાં cobalt catalyst પર air સાથે oxidise કરી disulfides બનાવી sweeten કરે છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Extractor: sour feed caustic solution ના સંપર્કમાં આવે છે; mercaptans (acidic character) caustic માં mercaptides તરીકે ઓગળે છે.
  2. Oxidiser (regenerator): loaded caustic catalyst પર air ને મળે છે; mercaptides disulfides બને છે અને caustic ફરી વાપરવા regenerate થાય છે.
  3. Separator તથા settler: disulfide oil regenerated caustic થી છૂટું પડે છે; liquid–liquid MEROX માં તે design ની product stream arrangement સાથે દૂર થાય છે, અને sweet product specification મુજબ ધોવાય/sand થાય છે.

Working — sequence and reason

Extraction: RSH + NaOH → RSNa + H2O
Regeneration: 4 RSNa + O2 + 2 H2O → 2 (RS)2 + 4 NaOH

Caustic regenerate થતું હોવાથી, MEROX મુખ્યત્વે air અને થોડું make-up caustic વાપરે છે, Doctor solution તથા તેના lead waste ને બદલે છે. Fixed-bed MEROX ભારે stocks માટે એ જ oxidation સીધું catalyst bed પર લાગુ કરે છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Doctor treatment ની જેમ, MEROX કુલ sulfur ખાસ ઘટાડ્યા વગર sweeten કરે છે (mercaptan sulfur disulfide તરીકે રહે છે, extraction designs માં મોટેભાગે caustic loop સાથે છૂટું પડે છે). Caustic handling તથા mercaptan દુર્ગંધ માટે closed systems તથા refinery PPE/procedures જોઈએ છે.

h.en: 4.3 Treatment of kerosene by liquid SO2 extraction (Edeleanu process) — construction and working
h.gu: 4.3 Liquid SO2 extraction થી kerosene ની treatment (Edeleanu process) — construction તથા working

body.en:
Definition / principle

The Edeleanu process treats kerosene with liquid sulfur dioxide, which selectively dissolves aromatics and sulfur compounds, leaving a paraffinic kerosene of high smoke point and good burning quality.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Extraction column: refrigerated liquid SO2 and kerosene flow countercurrently; aromatics-rich extract leaves below, treated raffinate above (low temperature, of the order of −10 °C, sharpens selectivity — process-dependent).
  2. Solvent recovery (evaporators/strippers): SO2 is boiled off both raffinate and extract and recycled; the extract becomes an aromatic-rich by-product stream.
  3. Drying/finishing: traces of SO2 are removed from the raffinate (caustic wash/drying) before storage.

Working — sequence and reason

Selectivity comes from solubility: SO2 prefers aromatic and sulfur-bearing molecules, so removing them raises smoke point (Unit II) and lowers sulfur together — a physical separation (Unit I), not a reaction. Refrigeration and complete solvent recovery decide the operating cost, because SO2 is toxic and must stay in a closed loop.

Limitations and safety

Liquid SO2 is toxic and corrosive when wet; the unit is a closed, refrigerated system under strict procedures. Modern refineries often hydrotreat kerosene instead, but the syllabus retains SO2 extraction as the classic selective-extraction example.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Edeleanu process kerosene ને liquid sulfur dioxide સાથે treat કરે છે, જે aromatics તથા sulfur compounds ને પસંદગીથી ઓગાળે છે, high smoke point તથા સારી burning quality વાળું paraffinic kerosene છોડે છે.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Extraction column: refrigerated liquid SO2 તથા kerosene countercurrently વહે છે; aromatics-rich extract નીચેથી, treated raffinate ઉપરથી નીકળે છે (નીચું temperature, આશરે −10 °C ક્રમનું, selectivity sharp કરે છે — process-આધારિત).
  2. Solvent recovery (evaporators/strippers): SO2 raffinate તથા extract બંનેમાંથી ઊકાળી recycle થાય છે; extract aromatic-rich by-product stream બને છે.
  3. Drying/finishing: storage પહેલાં raffinate માંથી SO2 ના traces દૂર થાય છે (caustic wash/drying).

Working — sequence and reason

Selectivity solubility માંથી આવે છે: SO2 aromatic તથા sulfur-bearing molecules ને પસંદ કરે છે, તેથી તેમને દૂર કરવાથી smoke point (Unit II) વધે છે અને sulfur સાથે ઘટે છે — એક physical separation (Unit I), reaction નહીં. Refrigeration તથા સંપૂર્ણ solvent recovery operating cost નક્કી કરે છે, કારણ કે SO2 toxic છે અને closed loop માં રહેવું જોઈએ.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Liquid SO2 toxic છે અને ભીનું હોય ત્યારે corrosive છે; unit કડક procedures હેઠળ closed, refrigerated system છે. આધુનિક refineries ઘણીવાર તેના બદલે kerosene hydrotreat કરે છે, પણ syllabus SO2 extraction ને classic selective-extraction example તરીકે જાળવે છે.

h.en: Derivation: single-stage solvent-extraction balance and the lever rule
h.gu: Derivation: single-stage solvent-extraction balance તથા lever rule

body.en:
Symbols, model and assumptions

One ideal (equilibrium) extraction stage; feed F of composition wF (mass fraction of the extracted component, e.g. aromatics), fresh solvent S (taken solute-free for this derivation); mixture M splits into extract E (composition wE) and raffinate R (composition wR) in equilibrium. Same component and mass basis throughout.

  1. Write the overall and component balances.

    M = F + S; M = E + R
    F·wF + S·0 = E·wE + R·wR; mixture composition zM = F·wF / M

  2. Replace R by (M − E) in the component balance written about the mixture.

    M·zM = E·wE + (M − E)·wR

  3. Collect the E terms and divide.

    E·(wE − wR) = M·(zM − wR)

  4. State the extract amount and the lever rule.

    E = M·(zM − wR) / (wE − wR), R = M − E
    E / R = (zM − wR) / (wE − zM) (lever rule: amounts ∝ opposite arms)

4-mark / 7-mark study depth

4-mark path: stage balance → mixture composition → substitute R → boxed lever rule, with equilibrium endpoints stated as data (they are read from equilibrium/tie-line data, never guessed). For a full 7-mark format include the component checks. These are study formats, not guaranteed official question marks. Numerical 4.N2 uses this result.
body.gu:
સંકેતો, Model તથા Assumptions

એક ideal (equilibrium) extraction stage; composition wF વાળો feed F (extracted component નો mass fraction, દા.ત. aromatics), fresh solvent S (આ derivation માટે solute-free લીધું); mixture M equilibrium માં extract E (composition wE) તથા raffinate R (composition wR) માં છૂટું પડે છે. સમગ્રમાં એક જ component તથા mass basis.

  1. Overall તથા component balances લખો.

    M = F + S; M = E + R
    F·wF + S·0 = E·wE + R·wR; mixture composition zM = F·wF / M

  2. Mixture વિશે લખેલા component balance માં R ને (M − E) થી બદલો.

    M·zM = E·wE + (M − E)·wR

  3. E વાળા terms એકત્ર કરી ભાગાકાર કરો.

    E·(wE − wR) = M·(zM − wR)

  4. Extract amount તથા lever rule જણાવો.

    E = M·(zM − wR) / (wE − wR), R = M − E
    E / R = (zM − wR) / (wE − zM) (lever rule: amounts ∝ opposite arms)

4-mark / 7-mark Study Depth

4-mark path: stage balance → mixture composition → R substitute કરો → boxed lever rule, equilibrium endpoints data તરીકે જણાવીને (તેઓ equilibrium/tie-line data માંથી વંચાય છે, કદી guess થતા નથી). Full 7-mark format માટે component checks સમાવો. આ study formats છે; official marks ની ખાતરી નથી. Numerical 4.N2 આ result વાપરે છે.

h.en: 4.4 Solvent extraction processes for lube oil — furfural extraction and phenol extraction
h.gu: 4.4 Lube oil માટે solvent extraction processes — furfural extraction તથા phenol extraction

body.en:
Definition / principle

Solvent refining improves lube-oil viscosity index and stability by extracting the aromatic, low-VI part of a vacuum lube distillate with a selective solvent — classically furfural or phenol — leaving a paraffinic/naphthenic raffinate as the lube base oil.

Construction — part and purpose (common to both solvents)

  1. Extraction tower: lube feed and solvent flow countercurrently (often in a rotating-disc or packed tower); solvent-rich extract leaves one end, raffinate the other.
  2. Solvent recovery trains: solvent is evaporated/stripped from both raffinate and extract and recycled — recovery decides the energy bill.
  3. Finishing: raffinate is dewaxed (topic 4.6) and hydrofinished/clay-treated to finished base oil; extract is used as aromatic oil/rubber extender or fuel component.

Comparison

PointFurfural extractionPhenol extraction
Selectivity targetAromatics and sulfur/resinous compounds; high raffinate yield for a given VI gainAlso aromatics; strong solvent power, historically the first lube extraction solvent
Handling noteSolvent oxidises/polymerises if air enters; closed, blanketed system and careful recoveryPhenol is toxic and absorbed through skin; strict closed handling and PPE
Product effectBoth raise VI, lighten colour and improve oxidation stability of the raffinate; neither removes wax — dewaxing follows

Qualification

Extraction trades yield for quality: pushing for higher VI dissolves more good oil into the extract, so solvent ratio and temperature are set at the economic optimum, and modern units may use NMP as a safer alternative solvent — the balance and lever-rule working of any of them is the derivation above.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Solvent refining vacuum lube distillate ના aromatic, low-VI ભાગને પસંદગીના solvent — classically furfural કે phenol — થી extract કરી lube-oil viscosity index તથા stability સુધારે છે, paraffinic/naphthenic raffinate ને lube base oil તરીકે છોડે છે.

Construction — part and purpose (બંને solvents માટે સામાન્ય)

  1. Extraction tower: lube feed તથા solvent countercurrently વહે છે (ઘણીવાર rotating-disc કે packed tower માં); solvent-rich extract એક છેડેથી, raffinate બીજા છેડેથી નીકળે છે.
  2. Solvent recovery trains: solvent raffinate તથા extract બંનેમાંથી evaporate/strip થઈ recycle થાય છે — recovery energy bill નક્કી કરે છે.
  3. Finishing: raffinate dewax થાય છે (topic 4.6) અને finished base oil માટે hydrofinish/clay-treat થાય છે; extract aromatic oil/rubber extender કે fuel component તરીકે વપરાય છે.

Comparison

મુદ્દોFurfural extractionPhenol extraction
Selectivity targetAromatics તથા sulfur/resinous compounds; આપેલા VI gain માટે high raffinate yieldપણ aromatics; મજબૂત solvent power, ઐતિહાસિક રીતે પ્રથમ lube extraction solvent
Handling noteAir પ્રવેશે તો solvent oxidise/polymerise થાય છે; closed, blanketed system તથા કાળજીપૂર્વક recoveryPhenol toxic છે અને skin દ્વારા શોષાય છે; કડક closed handling તથા PPE
Product effectબંને VI વધારે છે, colour હલકો કરે છે અને raffinate ની oxidation stability સુધારે છે; કોઈ wax દૂર કરતું નથી — dewaxing પછી આવે છે

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Extraction quality માટે yield નો વેપાર કરે છે: વધુ VI માટે ધકેલવાથી વધુ સારું oil extract માં ઓગળે છે, તેથી solvent ratio તથા temperature economic optimum પર નક્કી થાય છે, અને આધુનિક units સુરક્ષિત વૈકલ્પિક solvent તરીકે NMP વાપરી શકે છે — તેમાંથી કોઈનું પણ balance તથા lever-rule working ઉપરનું derivation છે.

h.en: 4.5 Purpose of dewaxing — why wax must leave a lubricant
h.gu: 4.5 Dewaxing નો હેતુ — lubricant માંથી wax કેમ જવું જોઈએ

body.en:
Definition / principle

Dewaxing removes the long normal-paraffin wax from lube fractions so that the oil still flows at low temperature — that is, to lower its pour point to specification.

Detailed theory and conditions

The same long paraffin chains that give a lube fraction good viscosity index crystallise as interlocking wax plates when the oil is cooled (Unit II: cloud then pour). An oil carrying its wax can set almost solid in a cold engine or gearbox even though its room-temperature viscosity is perfect. Dewaxing therefore chills the oil so the wax crystallises in a filterable form and removes the crystals, producing (i) dewaxed oil of low pour point and (ii) wax as a saleable by-product (Unit I). The deeper the dewaxing (lower target pour point), the more oil is trapped with the wax and the lower the yield — pour-point specification is again an economic compromise, and catalytic dewaxing (cracking/isomerising the wax molecules instead of filtering them out) is the modern alternative noted for completeness.

Key points and data

  • Target: pour point set by the lubricant grade and climate, verified by the Unit II pour-point test.
  • Two families: without solvent (cold settling/pressing, centrifuging — topic 4.6(a)) and with solvent (ketone dewaxing — topic 4.6(b)).
  • By-product: slack wax, de-oiled further to finished paraffin/microcrystalline wax grades.

Qualification

Dewaxing cannot be judged on pour point alone: a process that reaches pour point by removing too much oil with the wax destroys yield, so oil content of the wax and filtration rate are controlled together.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Dewaxing lube fractions માંથી લાંબું normal-paraffin wax દૂર કરે છે જેથી oil નીચા temperature પર પણ વહે — એટલે કે, તેનો pour point specification સુધી નીચે લાવવા.

વિગતવાર Theory તથા Conditions

Lube fraction ને સારો viscosity index આપતી એ જ લાંબી paraffin chains oil ઠંડું પડતાં એકબીજામાં ગૂંથાતી wax plates તરીકે crystallise થાય છે (Unit II: પહેલાં cloud પછી pour). Wax ધરાવતું oil ઠંડા engine કે gearbox માં લગભગ ઘન જામી શકે છે જોકે તેની room-temperature viscosity સંપૂર્ણ હોય. તેથી dewaxing oil ને ઠંડું કરે છે જેથી wax filterable સ્વરૂપમાં crystallise થાય અને crystals દૂર થાય છે, (i) નીચા pour point વાળું dewaxed oil અને (ii) વેચી શકાય તેવા by-product તરીકે wax મળે છે (Unit I). Dewaxing જેટલું ઊંડું (નીચો target pour point), તેટલું વધુ oil wax સાથે ફસાય છે અને yield ઘટે છે — pour-point specification ફરી economic સમાધાન છે, અને catalytic dewaxing (wax molecules ને filter કરવાને બદલે crack/isomerise કરવું) સંપૂર્ણતા માટે નોંધેલ આધુનિક વિકલ્પ છે.

મુખ્ય મુદ્દા તથા data

  • Target: lubricant grade તથા climate થી નક્કી થતો pour point, Unit II pour-point test થી verified.
  • બે families: solvent વગર (cold settling/pressing, centrifuging — topic 4.6(a)) અને solvent સાથે (ketone dewaxing — topic 4.6(b)).
  • By-product: slack wax, finished paraffin/microcrystalline wax grades માટે વધુ de-oil થાય છે.

મર્યાદા / Qualification

Dewaxing ને ફક્ત pour point પરથી જજ કરી શકાતું નથી: wax સાથે વધુ પડતું oil દૂર કરી pour point સુધી પહોંચતી process yield નાશ કરે છે, તેથી wax નું oil content તથા filtration rate સાથે નિયંત્રિત થાય છે.

h.en: 4.6 Dewaxing techniques — without solvent, and with solvent (ketone dewaxing: construction and working)
h.gu: 4.6 Dewaxing techniques — solvent વગર, અને solvent સાથે (ketone dewaxing: construction તથા working)

body.en:
Definition / principle

Dewaxing techniques divide by whether a solvent is used to control wax crystallisation: without solvent, the chilled oil itself must give filterable crystals; with solvent (ketone dewaxing), a ketone–aromatic solvent mixture makes crystallisation and filtration controllable and fast.

Classification / representative type

TechniqueHow wax is separatedCharacter
Cold settling / cold pressing (no solvent)Oil chilled slowly; wax settles or is pressed from the chilled mass in filter pressesOldest route; slow, labour-heavy, limited to easily crystallising stocks
Centrifugal dewaxing (no solvent)Chilled oil spun in centrifuges; denser wax thrown outContinuous but limited separation sharpness
Ketone (solvent) dewaxingOil diluted with MEK–toluene type solvent, chilled, wax filtered on rotary vacuum filtersStandard modern route: controllable pour point and filtration rate

Construction — part and purpose (ketone dewaxing)

  1. Solvent mixing and chilling train: waxy oil is mixed with solvent and chilled (scraped-surface chillers with refrigeration) to the filtration temperature set by the target pour point.
  2. Rotary vacuum drum filter: wax crystals are caught on the rotating drum cloth, washed with cold solvent, and scraped off as slack wax.
  3. Solvent recovery: solvent is evaporated/stripped from both dewaxed oil and wax and recycled; refrigeration and recovery dominate cost.

Working — sequence and reason

In the solvent mixture the ketone component precipitates wax and keeps viscosity low when cold, while the aromatic component keeps the oil dissolved — the blend ratio tunes crystal size so the filter passes oil quickly but holds wax. The worked wax balance is Numerical 4.N3.

Limitations and safety

Ketone solvents are flammable and the unit is refrigerated and closed; operation follows refinery procedures. Filtration temperature below need wastes refrigeration and oil yield, so it is set from the pour-point target, not 'as cold as possible'.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / સિદ્ધાંત

Dewaxing techniques wax crystallisation નિયંત્રિત કરવા solvent વપરાય છે કે કેમ તે પરથી વહેંચાય છે: solvent વગર, ઠંડું પડેલું oil પોતે filterable crystals આપવું જોઈએ; solvent સાથે (ketone dewaxing), ketone–aromatic solvent mixture crystallisation તથા filtration ને નિયંત્રિત તથા ઝડપી બનાવે છે.

Classification / representative type

TechniqueWax કેવી રીતે છૂટું પડે છેCharacter
Cold settling / cold pressing (solvent નહીં)Oil ધીમે ઠંડું થાય; wax બેસી જાય કે ઠંડા mass માંથી filter presses માં દબાય છેસૌથી જૂનો માર્ગ; ધીમો, labour-heavy, સહેલાઈથી crystallise થતા stocks સુધી મર્યાદિત
Centrifugal dewaxing (solvent નહીં)ઠંડું oil centrifuges માં ફરે છે; વધુ ઘટ્ટ wax બહાર ફેંકાય છેContinuous પણ separation sharpness મર્યાદિત
Ketone (solvent) dewaxingOil MEK–toluene પ્રકારના solvent સાથે dilute થઈ, ઠંડું થઈ, rotary vacuum filters પર wax filter થાય છેStandard આધુનિક માર્ગ: નિયંત્રિત pour point તથા filtration rate

Construction — part and purpose (ketone dewaxing)

  1. Solvent mixing તથા chilling train: waxy oil solvent સાથે ભળી target pour point થી નક્કી filtration temperature સુધી ઠંડું થાય છે (refrigeration સાથે scraped-surface chillers).
  2. Rotary vacuum drum filter: wax crystals ફરતા drum cloth પર પકડાય છે, ઠંડા solvent થી ધોવાય છે, અને slack wax તરીકે ઉખેડાય છે.
  3. Solvent recovery: solvent dewaxed oil તથા wax બંનેમાંથી evaporate/strip થઈ recycle થાય છે; refrigeration તથા recovery ખર્ચ પર પ્રભુત્વ ધરાવે છે.

Working — sequence and reason

Solvent mixture માં ketone component wax ને precipitate કરે છે અને ઠંડીમાં viscosity નીચી રાખે છે, જ્યારે aromatic component oil ને ઓગળેલું રાખે છે — blend ratio crystal size ને એ રીતે tune કરે છે કે filter oil ને ઝડપથી પસાર કરે પણ wax ને રોકે. Worked wax balance Numerical 4.N3 માં છે.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા safety

Ketone solvents flammable છે અને unit refrigerated તથા closed છે; operation refinery procedures મુજબ થાય છે. જરૂર કરતાં નીચું filtration temperature refrigeration તથા oil yield બગાડે છે, તેથી તે pour-point target પરથી નક્કી થાય છે, 'શક્ય તેટલું ઠંડું' એમ નહીં.

h.en: Activity: Treatment-route selection exercise for three refinery streams (guided)
h.gu: Activity: ત્રણ refinery streams માટે treatment-route selection exercise (guided)

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to choose, with reasons, a treatment route for (a) sour LPG failing the Doctor test, (b) kerosene failing smoke point, and (c) waxy lube distillate failing pour point. Materials: this unit's cards, Unit II property tests and blank selection table in the journal.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. For each stream, name the offending component (mercaptans; aromatics/sulfur; wax) from the failing test.
  2. Choose the mildest route that removes or converts that component: MEROX/sweetening, SO2 extraction or hydrotreating, ketone dewaxing — and state what the route does not do.
  3. Present one choice and defend it against the next-stronger alternative on cost and specification grounds.

Precautions

Selections must follow the failing property, not habit. No chemicals are handled in this activity; any laboratory demonstration is arranged and supervised separately by the institute.

Observations and result

Blank record: stream ___, failing test ___, route chosen ___, what it will not achieve ___. Selection exercise only; no treatment is claimed to have been performed.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: (a) Doctor test માં fail થતા sour LPG, (b) smoke point માં fail થતા kerosene, અને (c) pour point માં fail થતા waxy lube distillate માટે, કારણો સાથે, treatment route પસંદ કરવો. Materials: આ unit ના cards, Unit II property tests અને journal માં blank selection table.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. દરેક stream માટે, fail થતા test પરથી વાંધાજનક component નું નામ આપો (mercaptans; aromatics/sulfur; wax).
  2. તે component ને દૂર કરતો કે ફેરવતો સૌથી હળવો route પસંદ કરો: MEROX/sweetening, SO2 extraction કે hydrotreating, ketone dewaxing — અને route શું કરશે નહીં તે જણાવો.
  3. એક પસંદગી રજૂ કરો અને ખર્ચ તથા specification ના આધારે તેનાથી વધુ મજબૂત વિકલ્પ સામે તેનો બચાવ કરો.

Precautions

પસંદગીઓ fail થતા property ને અનુસરવી જોઈએ, ટેવને નહીં. આ activity માં કોઈ chemicals handle થતા નથી; કોઈ laboratory demonstration સંસ્થા દ્વારા અલગથી ગોઠવાય અને supervise થાય છે.

h.en: Practice 1. Discuss the purposes of sulfur removal and compare sweetening, extractive treatment and catalytic desulfurisation.
h.gu: Practice 1. Sulfur removal ના હેતુઓ ચર્ચો અને sweetening, extractive treatment તથા catalytic desulfurisation ની સરખામણી કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Sulfur corrodes, poisons catalysts, smells, destabilises products and becomes SOx on burning.

Comparison

  • Sweetening (Doctor/MEROX): mercaptans to disulfides, total S nearly unchanged, cheapest.
  • Extractive (caustic, SO2): part of S/aromatics physically removed, solvent recovered.
  • Catalytic desulfurisation: all S forms to H2S with hydrogen; only route to ultra-low sulfur, costliest.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Sulfur corrode કરે છે, catalysts ને poison કરે છે, દુર્ગંધ આપે છે, products અસ્થિર કરે છે અને બળતાં SOx બને છે.

Comparison

  • Sweetening (Doctor/MEROX): mercaptans થી disulfides, કુલ S લગભગ યથાવત, સૌથી સસ્તું.
  • Extractive (caustic, SO2): S/aromatics નો ભાગ ભૌતિક રીતે દૂર, solvent recovered.
  • Catalytic desulfurisation: hydrogen સાથે તમામ S સ્વરૂપો H2S માં; ultra-low sulfur નો એકમાત્ર માર્ગ, સૌથી મોંઘો.

h.en: Practice 2. Explain Doctor's sweetening with reactions, and state why the process is now little used.
h.gu: Practice 2. Reactions સાથે Doctor sweetening સમજાવો, અને આ process હવે ઓછી કેમ વપરાય છે તે જણાવો.

body.en:
Definition

Sodium plumbite plus sulfur converts mercaptans to disulfides via lead mercaptide and black PbS.

Explanation and application

  • Reactions: 2RSH + Na2PbO2 → (RS)2Pb + 2NaOH; (RS)2Pb + S → (RS)2 + PbS.
  • Little used now: lead waste and total sulfur remaining in the fuel; MEROX and hydrotreating replaced it.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Sodium plumbite વત્તા sulfur mercaptans ને lead mercaptide તથા કાળા PbS મારફતે disulfides માં ફેરવે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Reactions: 2RSH + Na2PbO2 → (RS)2Pb + 2NaOH; (RS)2Pb + S → (RS)2 + PbS.
  • હવે ઓછું વપરાય છે: lead waste અને fuel માં રહેતું કુલ sulfur; MEROX તથા hydrotreating એ તેનું સ્થાન લીધું.

h.en: Practice 3. With a flow diagram, explain MEROX treatment: extraction, oxidation/regeneration and the fate of the caustic.
h.gu: Practice 3. Flow diagram સાથે MEROX treatment સમજાવો: extraction, oxidation/regeneration અને caustic નું ભાવિ.

body.en:
Definition

MEROX extracts mercaptans into caustic and oxidises them there to disulfides with air/cobalt catalyst.

Explanation and application

  • Extractor → oxidiser/regenerator → separator: caustic circulates (diagram ref4_merox).
  • Net consumption is mainly air and make-up caustic; sweetening only — total sulfur is not materially reduced.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

MEROX mercaptans ને caustic માં extract કરી ત્યાં air/cobalt catalyst થી disulfides માં oxidise કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Extractor → oxidiser/regenerator → separator: caustic circulate થાય છે (diagram ref4_merox).
  • Net વપરાશ મુખ્યત્વે air તથા make-up caustic છે; ફક્ત sweetening — કુલ sulfur ખાસ ઘટતું નથી.

h.en: Practice 4. Describe treatment of kerosene by liquid SO2 extraction (Edeleanu), including solvent recovery and the property it improves.
h.gu: Practice 4. Liquid SO2 extraction (Edeleanu) થી kerosene ની treatment વર્ણવો, solvent recovery તથા તે જે property સુધારે છે તે સહિત.

body.en:
Definition

Liquid SO2 selectively dissolves aromatics and sulfur compounds from kerosene (Edeleanu).

Explanation and application

  • Refrigerated countercurrent column; SO2 evaporated from raffinate and extract and recycled.
  • Improves smoke point and burning quality and lowers sulfur together.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Liquid SO2 kerosene માંથી aromatics તથા sulfur compounds ને પસંદગીથી ઓગાળે છે (Edeleanu).

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Refrigerated countercurrent column; SO2 raffinate તથા extract માંથી evaporate થઈ recycle થાય છે.
  • Smoke point તથા burning quality સુધારે છે અને sulfur સાથે ઘટાડે છે.

h.en: Practice 5. Compare furfural and phenol extraction for lube oils: solvent action, product effect and handling precautions.
h.gu: Practice 5. Lube oils માટે furfural તથા phenol extraction ની સરખામણી કરો: solvent action, product effect તથા handling precautions.

body.en:
Definition

Both are selective solvents that extract the aromatic, low-VI part of lube distillate.

Comparison

  • Effect: raffinate VI, colour and oxidation stability improve; wax is not removed.
  • Handling: furfural must be kept air-free (oxidation/polymerisation); phenol is toxic through skin — closed handling for both.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બંને પસંદગીના solvents છે જે lube distillate ના aromatic, low-VI ભાગને extract કરે છે.

Comparison

  • અસર: raffinate VI, colour તથા oxidation stability સુધરે છે; wax દૂર થતું નથી.
  • Handling: furfural air-free રાખવું જોઈએ (oxidation/polymerisation); phenol skin દ્વારા toxic છે — બંને માટે closed handling.

h.en: Practice 6. Explain the purpose of dewaxing and classify dewaxing techniques with one line on each.
h.gu: Practice 6. Dewaxing નો હેતુ સમજાવો અને dewaxing techniques નું classification દરેક પર એક line સાથે કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Dewaxing removes crystallisable long paraffins so the lube meets its pour-point specification.

Explanation and application

  • Without solvent: cold settling/pressing, centrifuging — simple, blunt.
  • With solvent: ketone dewaxing — controllable crystals and filtration, the standard route.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Dewaxing crystallisable લાંબા paraffins દૂર કરે છે જેથી lube તેના pour-point specification ને મળે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Solvent વગર: cold settling/pressing, centrifuging — સરળ, blunt.
  • Solvent સાથે: ketone dewaxing — નિયંત્રિત crystals તથા filtration, standard માર્ગ.

h.en: Practice 7. Describe ketone dewaxing: construction, working, and the roles of the two solvent components.
h.gu: Practice 7. Ketone dewaxing વર્ણવો: construction, working, અને બે solvent components ની ભૂમિકાઓ.

body.en:
Definition

Ketone dewaxing chills solvent-diluted waxy oil and filters the wax on rotary vacuum drums.

Explanation and application

  • Chilling train → rotary filter (wash, scrape slack wax) → solvent recovery from both products.
  • Ketone precipitates wax and thins the cold oil; toluene keeps oil dissolved and tunes crystal size.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ketone dewaxing solvent-diluted waxy oil ને ઠંડું કરી rotary vacuum drums પર wax filter કરે છે.

સમજૂતી તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Chilling train → rotary filter (wash, slack wax ઉખેડવું) → બંને products માંથી solvent recovery.
  • Ketone wax precipitate કરે છે અને ઠંડું oil પાતળું કરે છે; toluene oil ને ઓગળેલું રાખે છે અને crystal size tune કરે છે.

h.en: Practice 8. In one extraction stage, F = 100 kg (wF = 0.30), S = 100 kg, wE = 0.45, wR = 0.10. Calculate E and R by the lever rule, showing every step.
h.gu: Practice 8. એક extraction stage માં, F = 100 kg (wF = 0.30), S = 100 kg, wE = 0.45, wR = 0.10. દરેક step બતાવી lever rule થી E તથા R ગણો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

F = 100, wF = 0.30, S = 100 (solute-free), wE = 0.45, wR = 0.10, one equilibrium stage.

Step-by-step solution

M = 200; zM = 0.150; E = 200(0.150 − 0.10)/(0.45 − 0.10) = 28.57; R = 171.43 kg.

Interpretation and check

E = 28.6 kg, R = 171.4 kg (aromatics check 12.86 + 17.14 = 30.00 kg). Full working: Numerical 4.N2.
body.gu:
આપેલ તથા ધારણાઓ

F = 100, wF = 0.30, S = 100 (solute-free), wE = 0.45, wR = 0.10, એક equilibrium stage.

Step-by-step solution

M = 200; zM = 0.150; E = 200(0.150 − 0.10)/(0.45 − 0.10) = 28.57; R = 171.43 kg.

અર્થઘટન તથા check

E = 28.6 kg, R = 171.4 kg (aromatics check 12.86 + 17.14 = 30.00 kg). સંપૂર્ણ working: Numerical 4.N2.

q.en: Numerical 4.N1: A kerosene hydrotreater takes 2000 kg of kerosene with 0.30 % sulfur and makes product with 0.02 % sulfur (oil mass taken as 2000 kg). Calculate sulfur removed and efficiency, and compare the result with what Doctor sweetening of the same feed would do to total sulfur.
q.gu: Numerical 4.N1: Kerosene hydrotreater 0.30 % sulfur વાળું 2000 kg kerosene લઈ 0.02 % sulfur વાળું product બનાવે છે (oil mass 2000 kg લો). દૂર થતું sulfur તથા efficiency ગણો, અને એ જ feed ના Doctor sweetening થી કુલ sulfur ને શું થાત તેની સરખામણી કરો.

a.en:
Given

Oil = 2000 kg; sulfur in = 0.30 %; sulfur out in oil = 0.02 %. Teaching balance with oil mass unchanged (pattern of Numerical 3.N2).

Find

Find sulfur removed, removal efficiency, and state the Doctor-sweetening comparison.

Formula

Sulfur mass = oil mass × (S % / 100)
Efficiency % = removed / in × 100

Substitution and calculation

Sulfur in = 2000 × 0.0030 = 6.00 kg
Sulfur out = 2000 × 0.0002 = 0.40 kg
Sulfur removed = 6.00 − 0.40 = 5.60 kg
Efficiency = 5.60 / 6.00 × 100 = 93.33 %

Final answer with units

Sulfur removed = 5.60 kg; efficiency = 93.3 %

Validity check

Balance closes: 5.60 removed + 0.40 remaining = 6.00 kg in. Doctor sweetening of the same feed would leave total sulfur at about 6.00 kg in the oil (mercaptans merely converted to disulfides), passing the Doctor test but removing essentially nothing — the numerical difference between sweetening and desulfurisation.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Oil = 2000 kg; sulfur in = 0.30 %; oil માં sulfur out = 0.02 %. Oil mass યથાવત સાથે teaching balance (Numerical 3.N2 ની pattern).

શોધો

દૂર થતું sulfur, removal efficiency શોધો, અને Doctor-sweetening સરખામણી જણાવો.

સૂત્ર

Sulfur mass = oil mass × (S % / 100)
Efficiency % = removed / in × 100

Substitution તથા Calculation

Sulfur in = 2000 × 0.0030 = 6.00 kg
Sulfur out = 2000 × 0.0002 = 0.40 kg
Sulfur removed = 6.00 − 0.40 = 5.60 kg
Efficiency = 5.60 / 6.00 × 100 = 93.33 %

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Sulfur removed = 5.60 kg; efficiency = 93.3 %

Validity Check

Balance close થાય છે: 5.60 removed + 0.40 remaining = 6.00 kg in. એ જ feed નું Doctor sweetening કુલ sulfur ને oil માં આશરે 6.00 kg જ છોડત (mercaptans ફક્ત disulfides માં ફેરવાત), Doctor test pass કરત પણ લગભગ કંઈ દૂર ન કરત — sweetening તથા desulfurisation વચ્ચેનો numerical તફાવત.

q.en: Numerical 4.N2: In a single-stage furfural extraction, 100 kg of lube feed (aromatics mass fraction wF = 0.30) is mixed with 100 kg of fresh solvent. At equilibrium the extract has wE = 0.45 aromatics and the raffinate wR = 0.10 (given tie-line data). Using the derivation of card 4.4, calculate E, R and the percent of feed aromatics extracted.
q.gu: Numerical 4.N2: Single-stage furfural extraction માં, 100 kg lube feed (aromatics mass fraction wF = 0.30) 100 kg fresh solvent સાથે ભળે છે. Equilibrium પર extract માં wE = 0.45 aromatics અને raffinate માં wR = 0.10 છે (આપેલ tie-line data). Card 4.4 ના derivation નો ઉપયોગ કરી E, R અને feed aromatics ના extracted percent ગણો.

a.en:
Given

Feed F = 100 kg, wF = 0.30 aromatics. Fresh solvent S = 100 kg, solute-free. Equilibrium endpoints (given data, not guessed): wE = 0.45, wR = 0.10. One ideal stage.

Find

Find extract E, raffinate R, and the percentage of the feed aromatics that leaves in the extract.

Formula

M = F + S; zM = F × wF / M
E = M × (zM − wR) / (wE − wR); R = M − E

Substitution and calculation

M = 100 + 100 = 200 kg
zM = 100 × 0.30 / 200 = 0.150
E = 200 × (0.150 − 0.10) / (0.45 − 0.10) = 200 × 0.050 / 0.35 = 28.57 kg
R = 200 − 28.57 = 171.43 kg
Aromatics in E = 28.57 × 0.45 = 12.86 kg; feed aromatics = 30.00 kg
Extracted = 12.86 / 30.00 × 100 = 42.86 %

Final answer with units

E = 28.6 kg, R = 171.4 kg
Aromatics extracted in one stage = 42.9 %

Validity check

Component check: extract 12.86 kg + raffinate 171.43 × 0.10 = 17.14 kg gives 30.00 kg, closing the aromatics balance. One stage removes only part of the aromatics — the reason industrial extraction is multi-stage/countercurrent, exactly as the lever rule predicts from the endpoints.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Feed F = 100 kg, wF = 0.30 aromatics. Fresh solvent S = 100 kg, solute-free. Equilibrium endpoints (આપેલ data, guess નહીં): wE = 0.45, wR = 0.10. એક ideal stage.

શોધો

Extract E, raffinate R, અને feed aromatics ના કેટલા percent extract માં જાય છે તે શોધો.

સૂત્ર

M = F + S; zM = F × wF / M
E = M × (zM − wR) / (wE − wR); R = M − E

Substitution તથા Calculation

M = 100 + 100 = 200 kg
zM = 100 × 0.30 / 200 = 0.150
E = 200 × (0.150 − 0.10) / (0.45 − 0.10) = 200 × 0.050 / 0.35 = 28.57 kg
R = 200 − 28.57 = 171.43 kg
E માં aromatics = 28.57 × 0.45 = 12.86 kg; feed aromatics = 30.00 kg
Extracted = 12.86 / 30.00 × 100 = 42.86 %

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

E = 28.6 kg, R = 171.4 kg
એક stage માં aromatics extracted = 42.9 %

Validity Check

Component check: extract 12.86 kg + raffinate 171.43 × 0.10 = 17.14 kg એટલે 30.00 kg, aromatics balance close થાય છે. એક stage aromatics નો ભાગ જ દૂર કરે છે — industrial extraction multi-stage/countercurrent હોવાનું કારણ, બરાબર જેમ lever rule endpoints પરથી આગાહી કરે છે.

q.en: Numerical 4.N3: A ketone dewaxing unit treats 1000 kg of waxy lube oil containing 15 % wax. It produces 810 kg of dewaxed oil, 170 kg of slack wax and 20 kg of loss/handling difference. Calculate the wax removed as percent of feed wax, the dewaxed-oil yield, and check the balance.
q.gu: Numerical 4.N3: Ketone dewaxing unit 15 % wax ધરાવતા 1000 kg waxy lube oil ને treat કરે છે. તે 810 kg dewaxed oil, 170 kg slack wax અને 20 kg loss/handling difference આપે છે. Feed wax ના percent તરીકે દૂર થતું wax, dewaxed-oil yield ગણો, અને balance check કરો.

a.en:
Given

Feed = 1000 kg with 15 % wax (150 kg wax, 850 kg oil substance). Products stated: dewaxed oil 810 kg, slack wax 170 kg (wax plus oil carried with it), loss 20 kg. Illustrative plant-style yields.

Find

Check the overall balance and calculate dewaxed-oil yield % on feed.

Formula

Feed = dewaxed oil + slack wax + loss
Dewaxed-oil yield % = dewaxed oil / feed × 100

Substitution and calculation

Products total = 810 + 170 + 20 = 1000 kg
Dewaxed-oil yield = 810 / 1000 × 100 = 81.0 %
Oil carried into slack wax (by difference on oil substance) = 850 − 810 − (oil part of loss, neglected) ≈ 40 kg

Final answer with units

Dewaxed-oil yield = 81.0 %; slack wax = 170 kg; balance closes

Validity check

The slack wax (170 kg) exceeds the feed wax (150 kg) because it carries about 40 kg of oil with it — the yield loss that card 4.5 warns about, recovered only by further de-oiling of the wax. A dewaxing result reporting wax out greater than wax in without this explanation would be a balance error; with it, both total and component accounts are consistent.
a.gu:
આપેલ

Feed = 1000 kg, 15 % wax સાથે (150 kg wax, 850 kg oil substance). જણાવેલા products: dewaxed oil 810 kg, slack wax 170 kg (wax વત્તા તેની સાથે જતું oil), loss 20 kg. Illustrative plant-style yields.

શોધો

Overall balance check કરો અને feed પર dewaxed-oil yield % ગણો.

સૂત્ર

Feed = dewaxed oil + slack wax + loss
Dewaxed-oil yield % = dewaxed oil / feed × 100

Substitution તથા Calculation

Products total = 810 + 170 + 20 = 1000 kg
Dewaxed-oil yield = 810 / 1000 × 100 = 81.0 %
Slack wax માં જતું oil (oil substance પર તફાવતથી) = 850 − 810 − (loss નો oil ભાગ, અવગણ્યો) ≈ 40 kg

Units સાથે અંતિમ જવાબ

Dewaxed-oil yield = 81.0 %; slack wax = 170 kg; balance close થાય છે

Validity Check

Slack wax (170 kg) feed wax (150 kg) કરતાં વધે છે કારણ કે તે સાથે આશરે 40 kg oil લઈ જાય છે — card 4.5 જે yield loss ની ચેતવણી આપે છે તે જ, જે wax ના વધુ de-oiling થી જ પાછું મળે છે. આ સમજૂતી વગર wax out ને wax in કરતાં વધુ દર્શાવતું dewaxing result balance ભૂલ હોત; તેની સાથે, કુલ તથા component બંને હિસાબ સુસંગત છે.

items.f: Sweetening: RSH converted to (RS)2, total S almost unchanged. Removal: S out as H2S/solvent extract.

terms.gu: Doctor/MEROX odour તથા Doctor tests pass કરે છે; ફક્ત desulfurisation/extraction કુલ sulfur ઘટાડે છે.

terms.en: Same balance discipline as Numericals 3.N2 and 4.N1; state whether oil mass loss is neglected.
terms.gu: Numericals 3.N2 તથા 4.N1 જેવી જ balance શિસ્ત; oil mass loss અવગણ્યો છે કે કેમ તે જણાવો.

title.en: Unit 4 viva — sulfur removal, extraction, dewaxing
title.gu: Unit 4 viva — sulfur removal, extraction, dewaxing

q.en: Why must sulfur be removed from petroleum products?
q.gu: Petroleum products માંથી sulfur કેમ દૂર કરવું પડે છે?

a.en: It corrodes equipment, poisons catalysts, gives foul odour and poor stability, and forms sulfur oxides when the fuel burns.
a.gu: તે equipment ને corrode કરે છે, catalysts ને poison કરે છે, દુર્ગંધ તથા ખરાબ stability આપે છે, અને fuel બળતાં sulfur oxides બનાવે છે.

q.en: What is a mercaptan and why is it objectionable?
q.gu: Mercaptan શું છે અને તે વાંધાજનક કેમ છે?

a.en: A sulfur compound RSH with a penetrating foul smell; it is corrosive and makes petrol/LPG fail sweetness (Doctor) expectations even at low concentration.
a.gu: RSH sulfur compound છે જેમાં તીવ્ર દુર્ગંધ હોય છે; તે corrosive છે અને ઓછી concentration પર પણ petrol/LPG ને sweetness (Doctor) અપેક્ષાઓમાં fail કરે છે.

q.en: Distinguish sweetening from desulfurisation.
q.gu: Sweetening તથા desulfurisation વચ્ચે તફાવત કરો.

a.en: Sweetening converts mercaptans to disulfides and leaves total sulfur almost unchanged; desulfurisation removes sulfur from the oil, mainly as H2S with hydrogen.
a.gu: Sweetening mercaptans ને disulfides માં ફેરવે છે અને કુલ sulfur લગભગ યથાવત છોડે છે; desulfurisation oil માંથી sulfur દૂર કરે છે, મુખ્યત્વે hydrogen સાથે H2S તરીકે.

q.en: What happens chemically in Doctor sweetening?
q.gu: Doctor sweetening માં રાસાયણિક રીતે શું થાય છે?

a.en: Mercaptans form a lead mercaptide with sodium plumbite; added sulfur converts it to black lead sulfide and the disulfide, regenerating caustic.
a.gu: Mercaptans sodium plumbite સાથે lead mercaptide બનાવે છે; ઉમેરાયેલ sulfur તેને કાળા lead sulfide તથા disulfide માં ફેરવે છે, caustic regenerate કરે છે.

q.en: Expand MEROX and state its two steps.
q.gu: MEROX નું વિસ્તરણ કરો અને તેના બે steps જણાવો.

a.en: MERcaptan OXidation: extraction of mercaptans into caustic as mercaptides, then air oxidation over cobalt catalyst back to disulfides with caustic regenerated.
a.gu: MERcaptan OXidation: mercaptans નું caustic માં mercaptides તરીકે extraction, પછી cobalt catalyst પર air oxidation થી પાછા disulfides, caustic regenerate સાથે.

q.en: Why is catalytic desulfurisation called the deep route?
q.gu: Catalytic desulfurisation ને deep route કેમ કહે છે?

a.en: Because hydrogen over catalyst converts even refractory thiophene sulfur to H2S, reaching the ultra-low sulfur levels sweetening and washing cannot reach.
a.gu: કારણ કે catalyst પર hydrogen refractory thiophene sulfur ને પણ H2S માં ફેરવે છે, sweetening તથા washing પહોંચી ન શકે તેવા ultra-low sulfur levels સુધી પહોંચે છે.

q.en: What does liquid SO2 dissolve from kerosene in the Edeleanu process?
q.gu: Edeleanu process માં liquid SO2 kerosene માંથી શું ઓગાળે છે?

a.en: Aromatics and sulfur compounds, leaving a paraffinic raffinate of high smoke point; the SO2 is recovered from both streams and recycled.
a.gu: Aromatics તથા sulfur compounds, high smoke point વાળું paraffinic raffinate છોડીને; SO2 બંને streams માંથી recover થઈ recycle થાય છે.

q.en: What is the raffinate and what is the extract?
q.gu: Raffinate શું છે અને extract શું છે?

a.en: The raffinate is the treated oil stream leaving an extraction stage with the unwanted part reduced; the extract is the solvent-rich stream carrying the dissolved unwanted (here aromatic) part away.
a.gu: Raffinate એ extraction stage માંથી નીકળતી treated oil stream છે જેમાં અનિચ્છિત ભાગ ઘટ્યો હોય છે; extract એ solvent-rich stream છે જે ઓગળેલા અનિચ્છિત (અહીં aromatic) ભાગને દૂર લઈ જાય છે.

q.en: How do furfural and phenol extraction improve a lube oil?
q.gu: Furfural તથા phenol extraction lube oil ને કેવી રીતે સુધારે છે?

a.en: Both solvents extract the aromatic, low-viscosity-index part of the lube distillate, so the raffinate has higher VI, lighter colour and better oxidation stability.
a.gu: બંને solvents lube distillate ના aromatic, low-viscosity-index ભાગને extract કરે છે, તેથી raffinate નો VI વધુ, colour હલકો અને oxidation stability સારી હોય છે.

q.en: Why must a lube oil be dewaxed after solvent refining?
q.gu: Solvent refining પછી lube oil ને dewax કેમ કરવું પડે છે?

a.en: Solvent extraction does not remove wax; the long paraffins would crystallise on cooling and raise the pour point above specification.
a.gu: Solvent extraction wax દૂર કરતું નથી; લાંબા paraffins ઠંડીમાં crystallise થઈ pour point ને specification થી ઉપર લઈ જાત.

q.en: Name two dewaxing methods without solvent and state their drawback.
q.gu: Solvent વગરની બે dewaxing methods જણાવો અને તેમની ખામી કહો.

a.en: Cold settling/pressing and centrifugal dewaxing; both are slow or blunt in separation and suit only easily crystallising stocks compared with ketone dewaxing.
a.gu: Cold settling/pressing તથા centrifugal dewaxing; બંને ધીમી કે separation માં blunt છે અને ketone dewaxing ની સરખામણીએ ફક્ત સહેલાઈથી crystallise થતા stocks ને જ અનુકૂળ છે.

q.en: What two jobs do the ketone and the aromatic do in ketone dewaxing solvent?
q.gu: Ketone dewaxing solvent માં ketone તથા aromatic બે કયા કામ કરે છે?

a.en: The ketone precipitates wax and keeps cold viscosity low for filtering; the aromatic (toluene) keeps the oil dissolved, tuning crystal size and filtration rate.
a.gu: Ketone wax ને precipitate કરે છે અને filtering માટે ઠંડી viscosity નીચી રાખે છે; aromatic (toluene) oil ને ઓગળેલું રાખે છે, crystal size તથા filtration rate tune કરે છે.

q.gu: Practice: Sulfur removal ના હેતુઓ ચર્ચો અને sweetening, extractive treatment તથા catalytic desulfurisation ની સરખામણી કરો.

q.gu: Practice: Reactions સાથે Doctor sweetening સમજાવો, અને આ process હવે ઓછી કેમ વપરાય છે તે જણાવો.

q.gu: Practice: Flow diagram સાથે MEROX treatment સમજાવો: extraction, oxidation/regeneration અને caustic નું ભાવિ.

q.gu: Practice: Lube oils માટે furfural તથા phenol extraction ની સરખામણી કરો: solvent action, product effect તથા handling precautions.

q.gu: Practice: Ketone dewaxing વર્ણવો: construction, working, અને બે solvent components ની ભૂમિકાઓ.

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: to choose, with reasons, a treatment route for (a) sour LPG failing the Doctor test, (b) kerosene failing smoke point, and (c) waxy lube distillate failing pour point. Materials: this unit's cards, Unit II property tests and blank selection table in the journal.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. For each stream, name the offending component (mercaptans; aromatics/sulfur; wax) from the failing test.
  2. Choose the mildest route that removes or converts that component: MEROX/sweetening, SO2 extraction or hydrotreating, ketone dewaxing — and state what the route does not do.
  3. Present one choice and defend it against the next-stronger alternative on cost and specification grounds.

Precautions

Selections must follow the failing property, not habit. No chemicals are handled in this activity; any laboratory demonstration is arranged and supervised separately by the institute.

Observations and result

Blank record: stream ___, failing test ___, route chosen ___, what it will not achieve ___. Selection exercise only; no treatment is claimed to have been performed.
body.gu:
Aim and apparatus

Aim: (a) Doctor test માં fail થતા sour LPG, (b) smoke point માં fail થતા kerosene, અને (c) pour point માં fail થતા waxy lube distillate માટે, કારણો સાથે, treatment route પસંદ કરવો. Materials: આ unit ના cards, Unit II property tests અને journal માં blank selection table.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. દરેક stream માટે, fail થતા test પરથી વાંધાજનક component નું નામ આપો (mercaptans; aromatics/sulfur; wax).
  2. તે component ને દૂર કરતો કે ફેરવતો સૌથી હળવો route પસંદ કરો: MEROX/sweetening, SO2 extraction કે hydrotreating, ketone dewaxing — અને route શું કરશે નહીં તે જણાવો.
  3. એક પસંદગી રજૂ કરો અને ખર્ચ તથા specification ના આધારે તેનાથી વધુ મજબૂત વિકલ્પ સામે તેનો બચાવ કરો.

Precautions

પસંદગીઓ fail થતા property ને અનુસરવી જોઈએ, ટેવને નહીં. આ activity માં કોઈ chemicals handle થતા નથી; કોઈ laboratory demonstration સંસ્થા દ્વારા અલગથી ગોઠવાય અને supervise થાય છે.

Observations and result

Blank record: stream ___, failing test ___, પસંદ કરેલ route ___, તે શું સિદ્ધ કરશે નહીં ___. ફક્ત selection exercise; કોઈ treatment કર્યાનો દાવો નથી.
